product_summary: Transfer outstanding home loan balance from another bank to HDFC Bank at attractive interest rates with lower EMIs. Option to avail additional top-up loan up to ₹100 lakhs.

pricing.other_charges_notes: Conversion fees: 0.50% to 1.50% of principal outstanding; Miscellaneous charges at actuals; Re-appraisal fee ₹3,300-₹5,000; Administrative charges up to ₹5,000

collateral_accepted: Other collateral as required by HDFC Bank
documents_required: Bank statements (6 months for salaried; 12 months for business)
Balance Sheet and P&L statements (2 years for self-employed)
Outstanding balance letter from existing lender
key_features: Home loan approval in 4 simple steps
Customized repayment options (SURF, FLIP, Accelerated Repayment, Tranche-based EMI)
Interest rate same as regular home loans
Tax benefits on principal and interest per Income Tax Act 1961
Top-up loan facility up to ₹100 lakhs
Eligibility: minimum 12 months consistent repayment on existing loan
Maximum tenure: 30 years or retirement age (whichever lower)
For under-construction properties: tranche-based disbursement with interest-only payments initially
fees_table_raw: Processing Fee (Salaried/Self-Employed Professional): 0.50% or ₹4,000 (whichever higher); Self-Employed Non-Professional: 1.50% or ₹5,000 (whichever higher); NRI/Value Plus/HDFC Reach: 1.50-2.00% or ₹4,000-₹5,000 (whichever higher). Re-appraisal (6+ months): ₹3,300-₹5,000. Conversion fee (floating to fixed): ₹3,000. Foreclosure charges: 2% (fixed rate loans). Part-payment charges: None (adjustable rate); 2% (fixed rate, from own sources). Administrative charges: ₹5,000. Payment return: ₹450. Custody charges: ₹1,000/month (after 60 days post-closure). All charges exclusive of taxes.
